text: Bench press, dumbbell press, machine, push-ups... which one actually builds your chest?
They're all the same movement: pushing away from your chest. So they all train your chest, front shoulders, and triceps.

Barbell lets you lift the heaviest. Dumbbells give a deeper stretch, and each arm works alone. The machine is the most stable, so you can push close to failure safely. And push-ups need nothing but the floor.
Pick one heavy option and one stable option, and your chest is covered.
